description_en: Queries the lineage of a field in a metatable
description_zh: 调用GetMetaColumnLineage获取字段的血缘关系
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public get-meta-column-lineage --column-guid odps.engine_name.table_name.column_name --direction up --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --cluster-id abc --database-name abc --table-name abc --column-name abc --data-source-type emr --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMetaColumnLineage

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the field
parameters.name: column_guid

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query the ancestor or descendant lineage of the field. The value up indicates the ancestor lineage. The value down indicates the descendant lineage
parameters.help_zh: 字段的上下游方向：up表示上游，down表示下游
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.help_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the E-MapReduce (EMR) cluster. Configure this parameter only when you query data in an EMR compute engine instance
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the data source. Valid values: odps and emr
parameters.name: data_source_type
